profile.summary: Nanophotonics, optical modeling, nanofabrication, plasmonics, heat-assisted magnetic recording, machine learning, data analytics

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Computational optics modeling, simulation, and product development

positions.title: Technologist
positions.description:
Heat-assisted magnetic recording (HAMR) optics modeling and characterization 
- plasmonic nanoatenna + photonic integrated circuit + laser diode

positions.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
positions.description:
•	Photonic crystal nanocavities and photonic band gap materials; Electrically-driven photonic crystal nanolasers, high-efficiency single photon sources, deterministic coupling between ‘wet-chemically etched’ quantum dots and high-Q photon modes.
•	Metal based nanocavities; Plasmonics, high radiative efficiency plasmon nanolasers.
•	Light and matter interaction at deep subwavelength scale: Surface enhanced Raman scattering, nonlinear frequency conversion using optical nanoatennas.
•	Developing state-of-the art numerical simulation tools for various photonic nanostructures that incorporate metal and dispersive media; Finite-difference time-domain method and plane-wave expansion method.
•	Google Scholar Citation over 4,800 (h-index 31): https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=hrLEwDcAAAAJ&hl=en&oi=ao

positions.title: Research Assistant Professor
positions.description:
•	Interdisciplinary project on optofluidics -- to expand the scope of traditional microfluidics technology (Lab-on-a-chip) by integrating with micro- and nano-optics
•	First successful integration of photonic crystal nanolasers into a microfluidics chip, built into a nanolaser based chemical sensor on a chip.  
•	Design, optical characterization, and modeling of various SERS (Surface Enhanced Raman Scattering) active substrates for biochemical sensing, fabricated by bottom-up (self-assembly & microfluidics) & top-down (colloidal lithography) technologies.    
•	Design, optical characterization, and modeling of polymer based dye lasers 
•	Develop FDTD software for optical modeling and design 
•	Develop optical characterization setup including Q-switched YAG laser (w/ 2nd and 3rd harmonic modules), monochromator, UV grade high NA lens, etc. Labview software used for instrument control
